method: Serial production Chromium runs using the same benchmark script. Software SwiftShader; draw submission timings, not physical GPU/display latency. Controlled CNA delays verify presentation behavior, not scientific compute speed.

method.drawTiming: Input event to end of the actual target viewport render() call. Measures submitted draws; no gl.finish/fence and no promise of physical display latency.
method.uploadScope: Actual main atom RGB/visibility WebGL bufferData and bufferSubData calls, including frame uploads. Optional primitive/overlay buffers are excluded.
method.memoryScope: Chromium Runtime.getHeapUsage and performance.memory; excludes GPU memory, native/Wasm allocator reservations and Blob backing storage unless Chromium reports them separately.
method.cancellationScope: Separate direct production FrameParserPool probe in the same browser, not a UI seek. Worker ACK includes any remaining Blob read, numeric chunk and message transport; immediate client rejection is measured separately.
method.controlledCna: 100ms held completions, then real CPU CNA/CSP. These values verify continuity and upload behavior; do not interpret the artificial delay as calculation speed.
method.statistics: Nearest-rank percentiles; 24 scalar seeks and 6 controlled CNA seeks by default. Small samples and shared-host/SwiftShader noise limit timing conclusions.
